meta.prompt: A horizontal sprite strip of exactly 4 animation frames of a small paper lantern spirit floating, pixel art in the style of an ukiyo-e woodblock print: sumi ink black outlines, washi paper white, seal vermilion red accents, warm lantern orange and gold. The frames sit side by side in one row in equal-width cells, left to right in time order, same character, same size, same scale and same baseline in every cell, side view facing right. Flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background everywhere, no grid lines, no gaps of another color, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers.
